DeepSeek Harness plugin. Offload bulky tool logs to `refs/*.md`. Keep a Mermaid canvas in context. R
**CAUTION: don't pip the wrong dsh.** Official CLI: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`. The PyPI package `de
epseek-harness-cli` is a different tool (`dsh doctor` / `dsh chat`).
Writes `.dsh-memory/refs/{id}.md`, prints the canvas, recalls by id, and asserts the body matches.
